core_rule: HP and trauma are tracked separately before healing, but any actual HP heal cures all active trauma.

healing.full_hp_with_trauma_rule: A potion may still be consumed at full HP to trigger complete trauma recovery.
healing.example: 75% HP + sprain -> any HP heal cures the sprain; potion use is tactically valid even mainly for the trauma.

non_healing_stabilization.rule: If an effect does not restore HP, it may stabilize or reduce aggravation without counting as complete healing.

body_system_integration.injury_progression: normal impact -> persistent trauma -> severe fracture/lesion -> possible mutilation when attack and target rules permit

locked_rules: HP and trauma are distinct until healing occurs.
Trauma can occur while HP remains high.
Persistent injury families from LITD1 carry into LITD2.
Any actual HP healing cures all active trauma.
A potion may be used regardless of current HP percentage.
A potion may be used at full HP when trauma is active.
Trauma state feeds gore body-zone and persistent-corpse systems.
